HOW TO PLAY

Choose your play amount with the − and + buttons, then press the spin button. Space also spins. Every win is a multiple of the base play amount.

The speed button cycles normal speed, Turbo and Super Turbo. Autoplay plays the number of rounds you confirm and can be stopped at any time. The menu holds sound, music and these rules. Press during a win count to skip to the total.

The ante chip switches Alarm Boost on and off. PLAY FEATURE opens the feature cards. Every feature entry asks for confirmation first.

SYMBOLS & WINS

20 fixed win lines on 5 reels and 3 rows. Wins are awarded left to right on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost reel, as a multiple of the total play amount. Only the highest win on each line is awarded; wins on different lines are added together.

From highest to lowest: Fire Truck, Fire Helmet, Axe & Halligan, Extinguisher, Brass Nozzle, Water Bucket, Ladder, Fire Boots.

WILD — Chief Hamm. Substitutes for every symbol that wins (never for an alarm) and is worth the same as the Fire Truck on a line of its own. On reels 2 to 5 in the base game, Alarm Boost and Backdraft Spins; on all five reels in Rescue Spins and Inferno Rescue. A Backdraft can make a Blaze Wild on any reel, reel 1 included.
Fire Alarm — the bonus symbol, on every reel in the base game. 3 alarms: 10 spins · 4 alarms: 12 spins · 5 or more alarms: 15 spins of Rescue Spins. It does not form line wins.
Golden Alarm — counts as a Fire Alarm in every way. A trigger with at least one Golden Alarm starts Inferno Rescue instead.
WIN LINES

The 20 win lines, numbered as they light up on the reels. Each line wins from the leftmost reel.

BACKDRAFT

On a base game spin (Alarm Boost included) that does not start a feature, a Backdraft can sweep the reels: 2 to 5 cells that do not already show a WILD or an alarm burst into Blaze Wilds, on any reel including reel 1. Blaze Wilds are WILDs in every way. Line wins are then counted once, on the board after the Backdraft.

It never happens on a spin that starts a feature, and never inside Rescue Spins or Inferno Rescue. In Backdraft Spins every spin has one.

RESCUE SPINS

3 alarms: 10 spins · 4 alarms: 12 spins · 5 or more alarms: 15 spins. Above the reels stands a burning block with 5 rooms, one above each reel. Every room starts at fire level 2. WILDs appear on all five reels; no alarms appear, so the feature cannot start again from inside.

DOUSE
Every WILD on a reel sprays the room above it and lowers its fire level by 1 (two WILDs on one reel lower it by 2). A WILD under a room that is already safe does nothing more.

RESCUE
A room that reaches fire level 0 is rescued: the multiplier rises by +1 (it starts at ×1) and +1 spin is added.

NEXT BUILDING
When all 5 rooms are rescued the crew moves to the next building: every room is lit again, +5 spins are added and the multiplier is kept. It never resets.

Each spin's line wins are multiplied by the multiplier after that spin's rescues. The feature ends when the spins run out or the maximum win is reached. The multiplier has no ceiling.

INFERNO RESCUE

Rescue Spins under a red sky, started by a trigger with at least one Golden Alarm, from Alarm Call, or directly. Rooms start at fire level 1, so one WILD rescues a room.

RESCUE
Every rescue adds +2 to the multiplier and +1 spin, and the rescued pig carries an instant prize of 5× · 10× · 20× · 50× · 100× the base play amount, awarded at once and not multiplied.

Clearing all 5 rooms brings the next building and +5 spins, as in Rescue Spins.

ALARM CALL

Sprocket answers one call. It turns into Rescue Spins, Inferno Rescue (3%) or a False Alarm. A False Alarm wins nothing. An awarded feature starts with 10 spins and plays exactly like its own card.

BACKDRAFT SPINS

5 spins, and every spin gets a Backdraft of 3 to 5 Blaze Wilds. No alarms appear, so Rescue Spins cannot start. Line wins only.

MULTIPLIERS
Every Blaze Wild here carries a multiplier of ×2, ×3, ×5, ×10. A line that uses Blaze Wilds is multiplied by the SUM of their multipliers; a line that uses none counts ×1. WILDs from the reels carry no multiplier.

PLAY MODES
ALARM BOOST

1.5× the play amount. A toggle: every spin is played at 1.5× the base play amount and has 2× the chance to start Rescue Spins and 2× the chance to start Inferno Rescue. The Backdraft rate is unchanged.

ALARM CALL

12× the play amount. Enters one Alarm Call.

RESCUE SPINS

18× the play amount. Enters Rescue Spins directly, with 10 spins.

BACKDRAFT SPINS

50× the play amount. Enters Backdraft Spins directly.

INFERNO RESCUE

90× the play amount. Enters Inferno Rescue directly, with 10 spins.

RETURN & MAXIMUM WIN

Theoretical return: 96.70% in every mode (base game, ALARM BOOST, ALARM CALL, RESCUE SPINS, BACKDRAFT SPINS, INFERNO RESCUE).

The maximum win is 15,000× the base play amount in every mode. A round that reaches it ends at once and awards the maximum.

GENERAL INFORMATION

Malfunction voids all wins and plays. A consistent internet connection is required. In the event of a disconnection, reload the game to finish any uncompleted rounds. The expected return is calculated over many plays. The game display is not representative of any physical device and is for illustrative purposes only. Winnings are settled according to the amount received from the Remote Game Server and not from events within the web browser. TM and © 2026 Engine.
